en: Black‑and‑white view down a cobblestone street in a European town. Two- and three‑story brick and stucco houses line both sides, many with steep gabled roofs and dormer windows. Trees and picket fences border the sidewalks. In the distance a tall industrial smokestack rises against low hills, and a church or town‑hall tower with a clock or cross is visible to the right. Several pedestrians, a few standing in groups, and a horse‑drawn cart occupy the street; a man stands on the right foreground near a fence. The sky area shows damage or overexposure, suggesting an old photograph reproduced on a postcard. There is some faint, nearly illegible writing or emulsion scratching at the top center.
